title: FAA UAP reports, batch 06 (237UAP00132 - 237UAP00157)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings, many of which were identified as balloons.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported two bright lights following it.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was 2 bright lights following aircraft.

incidents.summary: Multiple commercial flights reported orbs of light moving in various directions.
incidents.quote: They reported Orbs of light moving in various directions.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported flashing lights.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported as flashing lights

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a small circular object with flashing white lights.
incidents.quote: a small circular object with flashing white lights

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported red, green, and white lights fading in and out.
incidents.quote: red, green, and white lights fading in and out

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported two objects with red and white lights.
incidents.quote: appeared to be two aircraft with red and white lights

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an object with changing altitude, speed, and light intensity.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon had changed altitude, vertical speed and light intensity.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported an object descending into cloud cover.
incidents.quote: an object traveling SW bound descending into cloud base cover

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a shiny missile-like object traveling vertically.
incidents.quote: A projectile was observed climbing passing through FL360 with a smoke trail going straight up.

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported objects looking like stars turning on and off.
behavior: moving right to left and left to right
incidents.quote: looking like a star turning on and off every minute or so
